705340101.text: What's the point of having so many variations of the same tabletop game...

705340102.text: Ah, Traveler! Maybe give me a little warning next time? Are you here for the King of Invokations Grand Prix too?

705340105.text: Oh, this is a game designed by an adventurer from the Guild. They say it's an... innovative tabletop game that combines Genius Invokation TCG and combat. It's called "Heart of the Dice."

705340106.text: Since we're involved in organizing the King of Invokations Grand Prix, the Guild decided to host a minigame inspired by the adventurer's design.
